bio_chi_event.phenomenon: lineage-memory modulation changes later targeted-therapy resistance
bio_chi_event.intermediate_state: fraction of cells in the primed-for-resistance transcriptional state within the same lineage after 5 days
bio_chi_event.functional_outcome: resistant cells and resistant colonies after 5-day pretreatment followed by 4 weeks BRAFi/MEKi
bio_chi_event.primary_direction: PI3Ki should drive primed lineages toward the drug-susceptible state and reduce later resistance
bio_chi_event.reverse_direction_context: TGFB1 should drive fully drug-susceptible control lineages toward the primed state; treated as mechanistic complement, not required for the primary gate

state_switch_gate.eligibility: lineages present in Control and PI3Ki rows of the source sheet
state_switch_gate.pass_rule: median delta < 0 and at least 6 of the 8 source lineages have delta < 0
state_switch_gate.exact_sign_test: one-sided exact binomial on negative deltas, zeros excluded and reported separately
state_switch_gate.p_value_role: resolution/consistency diagnostic only; not a promotion threshold

reverse_switch_context.report: median delta, positive/negative/zero lineage counts and one-sided exact sign p
reverse_switch_context.role: contextual reverse-direction check; failure does not rescue or overturn the primary PI3Ki gate

functional_gate.technical_replication_control: aggregate technical wells/cells to one mean per biological replicate within condition before direction testing
functional_gate.pass_rule: all source-defined biological replicates evaluable in each endpoint must have PI3Ki < Control for both resistant-cell and resistant-colony replicate means
functional_gate.exact_sign_test: one-sided exact binomial per endpoint over biological replicates

bio_chi_promotion.supported_if: state_switch_gate passes AND functional_gate passes in both resistance endpoints
bio_chi_promotion.interpretation_if_supported: within-source P0-Q relation linking same-lineage state-memory modulation to later resistance, not a universal law and not independent P1 confirmation

downward_modal_rule.required_representation: lineage-resolved two-state composition is the minimum internal organization needed for this event
downward_modal_rule.reason: the source defines the behaviorally relevant internal state directly as within-lineage primed versus drug-susceptible composition; extra PCA would be post-hoc ornament unless needed to explain a gate mismatch
downward_modal_rule.stochastic_generator_note: paper reports a two-state switching model, but no scalar or source-native generator is opened unless the top-down event requires additional compression after the frozen gates

scalar_gate.reason: whole-event identifiability does not require scalar compression; state composition and functional outcome are directly source-defined
